platformRoles.grantHint: Look the account up under Accounts first and paste its ID here. FursadHub has only these two platform roles, and what each may do is fixed in the API.
platformRoles.empty: No platform roles have been granted yet.
platformRoles.revokeDescription: This removes platform authority from {{holder}}. The grant stays in the history.

roleMeaning.SUPER_ADMIN: Full platform authority: statistics, accounts, platform roles, compliance, the audit trail, and every verification queue.
roleMeaning.VERIFICATION_OFFICER: Verification only: the organization and university queues and escalated student cases. No access to accounts, platform roles, compliance or the audit trail.

verificationOfficers.title: Verification officers
verificationOfficers.description: Create a verification officer account directly. They sign in with the username you choose, not their email address.
verificationOfficers.createHint: The officer becomes active straight away — no verification email is sent. Tell them the username and password you set here; neither is shown again.
verificationOfficers.usernameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens. This is what they type to sign in.
verificationOfficers.emailHint: Used for notifications and contact. It will not sign them in.
verificationOfficers.emptyHint: Create one here, or grant the role to an existing account below.
verificationOfficers.noUsername: Signs in with email — no username yet
verificationOfficers.editNameHint: How this officer appears across the admin area. A name is required — it cannot be removed once set.
verificationOfficers.assignUsernameWarning: This is permanent and cannot be changed later. From then on they sign in with the username instead of their email address, using the same password — tell them before you do this.
verificationOfficers.resetPasswordDescription: A new temporary password is generated for {{holder}} and shown once. They are signed out everywhere and their current password stops working.
verificationOfficers.credentialSignInHint: They sign in with this username and password.
